messages:
jules: Heads up team 1: were launching a "compatibility mode" in the SDK to make deprecations less painful for customers. Docs & SDK changes landing next week. Please skim the plan: https://redwood.internal/docs/sdk-compat-mode
priya: Nice. How does compat mode work exactly? Is it a runtime flag or build-time shim?
jules: It's a runtime flag + optional compile-time shim for typed SDKs. Default is OFF for new installs. When ON, the SDK will map deprecated params to their new equivalents and enable legacy response shaping.
dan: Can we scope it per-account? Some enterprise users need long habitability.
jules: Yes, compat mode can be enabled per-api-key or by environment variable on Dedicated/Private. We'll also expose an override in the Dashboard for enterprise CSMs to toggle.
release-bot: Canary: sdk-compat-mode-canary scheduled for 2025-01-14T15:00Z. Includes: compat runtime, telemetry events, and docs generator.
tara: Docs impact: we need a dedicated compatibility section and a generated migration report per release. I can own the doc templates if someone provides the schema.
priya: On telemetry - will compat mode emit additional signals so we know who relies on legacy behaviour?
jules: Yes, compat-mode emits anonymized events indicating which legacy mappings are used (no payloads). Well show aggregated counts in Console. Opt-out available via org settings.
docs-bot: Reminder: new docs site structure will split "guides" vs "reference" and add an automated "migration path" page.
dan: Example config snippet?
jules: ```json
{
  "redwood": {
    "compatibilityMode": {
      "enabled": true,
      "mappings": {
        "oldParam": "newParam",
        "useLegacyTokens": false
      }
    }
  }
}
```
priya: Will we backport this to older SDK minor versions?
jules: No backports except for CVEs. We'll ship compat mode in the next major + a patch canary for high-touch enterprise customers if needed.
tara: What's the rollout comms? I assume release notes + a migration report + in-console banner for 30 days?
jules: Correct. Plan: publish docs + migration generator, send email to active API keys, enable console banner on day 1 for 30 days. Add a "how to pin behavior" guide for platform engineers.
dan: QA ask: add an integration test that toggles compat mode and validates both shapes. Ill add that to the e2e suite.
priya: One more ask: add a lint in SDK that warns if code uses deprecated fields without a compat mapping.
jules: Agreed. We'll add lint + codemod generator to the SDK repo. Please tag @release and @docs when you open PRs.
release-bot: Note: launch checklist created: https://redwood.internal/board/sdk-compat-launch. Status: drafting.
tara: I'll draft the compatibility docs and attach migration templates. ETA EOD Tuesday.
jules: Thanks all 4dd. If any team needs early access to the canary, DM me.
